description: The JH-07 RTO serves the Gumla district in Jharkhand, handling all motor vehicle-related services including registration and licensing. This office transitioned from the Bihar-based code BR-41 following the state's formation and plays a key role in the transport administration of the South Chotanagpur division.
address: District Transport Office, Near S.D.O. Office, P.O. & P.S. Gumla, Jharkhand
